# Dependabot

Fetches dependabot alerts for GitHub repositories, and passes them through the CCF policy engine.

This plugin is intended to be run as part of an aggregate agent, and will execute the policy suite for each repository.

This page is for **operators** who run the `plugin-dependabot` plugin with the CCF Agent, and for **developers** who write policies for it. It documents [v0.8.0](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-dependabot/releases/tag/v0.8.0) and is generated from the plugin's [README at v0.8.0](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-dependabot/blob/v0.8.0/README.md).

## Requirements

### Authentication

To authenticate this plugin, you must provide a token which has at minimum the following permissions:

* Dependabot Alerts (read-only) - Used for reading alerts
* Administration (read-only) - Used to check whether a repository has alerts enabled

## Policies

The policy bundles that work with this plugin, at their newest releases. The controls are the ones the bundle's policies list in their metadata.

| Bundle | Latest version | Controls covered | Compatible plugin lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`plugin-dependabot-granular-policies`](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-dependabot-granular-policies) | `v0.2.0` | *none listed* | latest |

When writing OPA / Rego policies for this plugin, they must be added under the `compliance_framework` rego package:

```rego
# deny_critical_severity.rego
# package compliance_framework.[YOUR_RULE_PATH]
package compliance_framework.deny_critical_severity
```
